events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war has revealed the limits of US power and the rising geopolitical instability in the Middle East. The conflict has also shown the military strength of the US, but its waning geopolitical power. The war has become a powder keg, with strategic rivalries and the specter of regional war.
events.reasoning: The Iran war escalation will likely lead to increased volatility in the markets, with emerging markets being the most affected. The conflict will also lead to a safe-haven bid for gold, making it a good buy.

timeFrame.note: Monitor the situation and adjust accordingly

events.exitStrategy: Exit when the conflict de-escalates or when the gold price reaches $1800
